program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(is_bos@i & !is_a@i & !is_b@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & is_b@j | is_b@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j, !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_bos@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j | is_bos@i & !is_a@i & is_b@i & h1_1@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & is_b@j & h1_1@j, !is_a@i & !is_bos@j | is_b@i & !is_bos@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_1@j | is_b@i & h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_1@j, true)
h4_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & h2_1@j, !is_bos@j)
h5_1 = rightmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_1@j & !h3_1@j & !h4_1@j | !is_b@i & !h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_1@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_a@j & is_b@j | is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & !h3_1@j)
h6_1 = rightmost(!h5_1@i & !is_bos@j & is_b@j & h2_1@j | is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j, !h5_1@i | !h5_1@i & !is_bos@j)
h7_1 = rightmost(!is_b@i & h2_1@i & !h3_1@i & !h4_1@i & h5_1@i & h6_1@i & is_a@j & !is_b@j & h1_1@j & !h2_1@j & !h3_1@j & h4_1@j | !h3_1@i & !h4_1@i & h5_1@i & is_bos@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_1@j & !h3_1@j & h4_1@j & h5_1@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & h2_1@i & !h3_1@i & !h4_1@i & !h6_1@i & is_bos@j & is_b@j & h2_1@j & !h4_1@j & h5_1@j | !is_b@i & h1_1@i & !h3_1@i & !h4_1@i & h5_1@i & !h6_1@i & is_bos@j & is_b@j & h2_1@j & !h3_1@j & h4_1@j & h6_1@j)
h8_1 = rightmost(!h3_1@j & !h4_1@j & !h5_1@j | !h5_1@i, !h6_1@i & !h4_1@j & !h5_1@j | !h4_1@i & !h7_1@i & !h2_1@j & !h4_1@j & !h5_1@j)
h9_1 = rightmost(!h1_1@i & h5_1@i & !h6_1@i & is_bos@j & is_b@j & !h1_1@j | is_bos@i & is_a@i & h1_1@i & !h4_1@i & h5_1@i & !h6_1@i & h8_1@i & !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j & !h3_1@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h3_1@i & !h6_1@i & h8_1@i & is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_1@j & h3_1@j & !h4_1@j | !is_b@i & !h4_1@i & !h6_1@i & h7_1@i & !is_a@j & !h2_1@j & h4_1@j & !h6_1@j)
accept = !h5_1 & h6_1 & !h7_1 & !h8_1 & !h9_1 | !h5_1 & h6_1 & !h7_1 & !h8_1

output accept
